methods.label: Subtract the protractor readings
methods.explanation:
Use the same protractor scale for both rays. Starting from the left-hand \(0^\circ\) mark, ray \(BA\) reads about \(20^\circ\) and ray \(BD\) reads about \(160^\circ\). Their difference gives
\[
\angle ABD\approx160^\circ-20^\circ=140^\circ.
\]
Ray \(BC\) lies inside \(\angle ABD\), so this angle consists of \(\angle ABC\) and \(\angle CBD\). The given right angle \(CBD\) measures \(90^\circ\). Thus
\[
\angle ABC\approx140^\circ-90^\circ=50^\circ.
\]
The answer is approximately \(50^\circ\), choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
